# Agent HUD 0.4.34-beta.4
## Compatibility
**Requires Agent HUD for iPhone 1.4 or later** for iPhone and Apple Watch sync. Update the iPhone app before updating the Mac. Older iPhone versions cannot read this release's data.
[Get the iPhone app](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6812113619).
If the required iPhone version is not yet on the App Store, cross-device features require the corresponding TestFlight version.
Requires an Apple Silicon Mac running macOS 14 or later.
## Changes
- The New Version menu entry uses blue text while keeping the regular menu font.

# Agent HUD 0.4.38
## Compatibility
**Requires Agent HUD for iPhone 1.4 or later** for iPhone and Apple Watch sync. Update the iPhone app before updating the Mac. Older iPhone versions cannot read this release's data.
[Get the iPhone app](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6812113619).
Requires an Apple Silicon Mac running macOS 14 or later.
## Changes
- Restore a visible close button on expanded reply reminders. Closing a reply advances the event queue while leaving waiting permission requests unanswered. - Identify Grok Bot subagent billing conversations from their native session namespace, including subagents absent from the local conversation roster. Titles include their distinct IDs. Original billing identities and token totals are preserved without double counting; available native conversation metadata is joined only by exact ID.
